config.title: Top Models On OpenRouter (This Month)
config.description: Top 10 models by tokens so far this month, compared with the same days of last month. Rank change is against last month's ranking over those days.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
-- Month to date vs the same days of last month: last month only counts days up to
-- the latest day this month has data for, so a partial month compares like for like.
-- Dates arrive as ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD...), so month and day are sliced from the text.
-- Timeframe edges are local time but dates are UTC, so each table can spill a day into the
-- neighbouring month. Last month is the month most of LastMonth's rows fall in (it is never
-- empty, unlike ThisMonth on the 1st), and this month is the one after it.
WITH days AS (
    SELECT 'this' AS source, CAST(date AS VARCHAR) AS day, model_permaslug AS slug, total_tokens
    FROM ThisMonth
    WHERE model_permaslug <> 'other'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'last' AS source, CAST(date AS VARCHAR) AS day, model_permaslug AS slug, total_tokens
    FROM LastMonth
    WHERE model_permaslug <> 'other'
),
previous AS (
    SELECT mode(substr(day, 1, 7)) AS previous_month
    FROM days
    WHERE source = 'last'
),
months AS (
    SELECT
        strftime(CAST(previous_month || '-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m') AS month,
        previous_month
    FROM previous
),
cutoff AS (
    SELECT
        m.month,
        m.previous_month,
        (SELECT max(CAST(substr(day, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)) FROM days WHERE source = 'this' AND substr(day, 1, 7) = m.month) AS last_day
    FROM months m
),
this_month AS (
    SELECT d.slug, sum(d.total_tokens) AS tokens
    FROM days d, cutoff
    WHERE d.source = 'this' AND substr(d.day, 1, 7) = cutoff.month
    GROUP BY d.slug
),
last_month AS (
    SELECT
        d.slug,
        sum(d.total_tokens) AS tokens,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.total_tokens) DESC) AS rank
    FROM days d, cutoff
    WHERE d.source = 'last'
        AND substr(d.day, 1, 7) = cutoff.previous_month
        AND CAST(substr(d.day, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) <= cutoff.last_day
    GROUP BY d.slug
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        slug,
        tokens,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY tokens DESC) AS rank
    FROM this_month
),
by_slug AS (
    SELECT
        permaslug AS slug,
        id,
        name
    FROM Models
    -- Datasets key models by permaslug; a :batch model shares its base's, so keep one
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY permaslug ORDER BY length(id), id) = 1
)
SELECT
    r.rank,
    m.id,
    CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN '/drilldown/node?sourceId=Model%2F' || replace(replace(m.id, '/', '%2F'), ':', '%3A') || '&__configId={{configId}}' END AS url,
    COALESCE(m.name, r.slug) AS name,
    r.tokens,
    l.tokens AS lastTokens,
    (r.tokens - l.tokens) / l.tokens AS change,
    COALESCE('#' || CAST(l.rank AS VARCHAR), 'New') AS lastRank,
    l.rank - r.rank AS rankChange
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN last_month l ON l.slug = r.slug
LEFT JOIN by_slug m ON m.slug = r.slug
WHERE r.rank <= 10
ORDER BY r.rank

config.title: Intelligence Index Vs Input Price (Top 20)
config.description: Top 20 models by Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, against their input price. Higher and further left is better value.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH by_slug AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name AS model,
        author,
        inputPrice,
        "benchmarks.artificial_analysis.intelligence_index" AS intelligence
    FROM Models
    WHERE "benchmarks.artificial_analysis.intelligence_index" IS NOT NULL
        AND inputPrice IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY canonical_slug ORDER BY length(id), id) = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    model,
    '/drilldown/node?sourceId=Model%2F' || replace(replace(id, '/', '%2F'), ':', '%3A') || '&__configId={{configId}}' AS url,
    author,
    inputPrice,
    intelligence
FROM by_slug
ORDER BY intelligence DESC
LIMIT 20

config.title: Top GPQA Models By Accuracy And Cost
config.description: Top 15 models by accuracy on GPQA Diamond, graduate-level science questions that can't be answered by searching.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH by_slug AS (
    SELECT
        permaslug AS slug,
        id,
        name
    FROM Models
    -- Datasets key models by permaslug; a :batch model shares its base's, so keep one
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY permaslug ORDER BY length(id), id) = 1
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY b.score DESC) AS rank,
    m.id,
    CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN '/drilldown/node?sourceId=Model%2F' || replace(replace(m.id, '/', '%2F'), ':', '%3A') || '&__configId={{configId}}' END AS url,
    COALESCE(m.name, b.modelName) AS model,
    b.score AS accuracy,
    b.avgCostPerTask
FROM Benchmarks b
LEFT JOIN by_slug m ON m.slug = b.model
WHERE b.benchmark = 'gpqa_diamond' AND b.metric = 'accuracy'
ORDER BY b.score DESC
LIMIT 15

config.title: Top Models For Website Design
config.description: Top 15 models by Elo rating on Design Arena's website arena, from head-to-head votes. Win rate is how often voters picked the model's site.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH by_slug AS (
    SELECT
        permaslug AS slug,
        id
    FROM Models
    -- Datasets key models by permaslug; a :batch model shares its base's, so keep one
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY permaslug ORDER BY length(id), id) = 1
)
-- Design Arena's own names keep reasoning-effort variants apart (e.g. "(xhigh)", "Max")
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY b.score DESC) AS rank,
    m.id,
    CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN '/drilldown/node?sourceId=Model%2F' || replace(replace(m.id, '/', '%2F'), ':', '%3A') || '&__configId={{configId}}' END AS url,
    b.modelName AS model,
    b.score AS elo,
    b.winRate,
    b.avgDurationMs
FROM Benchmarks b
LEFT JOIN by_slug m ON m.slug = b.model
WHERE b.benchmark = 'website' AND b.metric = 'elo'
ORDER BY b.score DESC
LIMIT 15

config.title: Task Leaders
config.description: Models that are the most used model for at least one task on OpenRouter over the last 7 days, with the tasks they lead.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
-- One row per model that is the most used model for at least one task
WITH leaders AS (
    SELECT
        topModel AS slug,
        count(*) AS tasksLed,
        string_agg(DISTINCT category, ', ' ORDER BY category) AS categories,
        string_agg(task, ', ' ORDER BY usageShare DESC) AS leads,
        sum(usageShare) AS requestShare
    FROM Tasks
    WHERE topModel IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY topModel
),
by_slug AS (
    SELECT
        permaslug AS slug,
        id,
        name
    FROM Models
    -- Datasets key models by permaslug; a :batch model shares its base's, so keep one
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY permaslug ORDER BY length(id), id) = 1
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY l.tasksLed DESC, l.requestShare DESC) AS rank,
    m.id,
    CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN '/drilldown/node?sourceId=Model%2F' || replace(replace(m.id, '/', '%2F'), ':', '%3A') || '&__configId={{configId}}' END AS url,
    COALESCE(m.name, l.slug) AS model,
    l.tasksLed,
    l.categories,
    l.leads
FROM leaders l
LEFT JOIN by_slug m ON m.slug = l.slug
ORDER BY rank
